newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 25.

text.p: These are leading stories in the afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- French economy seen creating jobs for the first time in two years, report by national statistics office INSEE shows.
-- Lyonnaise des Eaux seen absorbing Suez for legal reasons, despite possible countermove by Generale des Eaux which may try to build opposition among Suez minority shareholders.
-- Peugeot may withdraw from China while General Motors plans to set up joint venture to build Buick cars in Shanghai.

-- Havas Advertising aims for ranking among top five world players, interested in developing in multimedia and the Internet, aims to pay down debt within two years before implementing an international growth strategy.
-- Sanofi to link up with U.S. Beckman in diagnosis systems.
-- Paris court wants Matra and Aerospatiale to reach an out-of-court agreement to end their conflict over a missiles deal.
